symptoms_summary: High latency (8200ms) and 45.2% error rate on checkout endpoint during flash sale traffic.
log_excerpt: 2026-09-29 14:30:02 ERROR [checkout-service] HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms. Active connections: 100/100, waiting threads: 45.
root_cause: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion caused by unindexed orders query combined with low HikariCP maxPoolSize (100) under peak checkout load.
resolution_steps:
1. Scaled HikariCP maxPoolSize from 100 to 250 in application.yml config.
2. Added composite B-tree index on orders table (user_id, status, created_at).
3. Restarted checkout service instances sequentially.

symptoms_summary: Backend CPU spiked to 98% with catalog response times jumping from 12ms to 3200ms across all product endpoints.
log_excerpt: 2026-09-28 09:15:22 WARN [catalog-api] Redis eviction policy volatile-lru triggered. 15,000 keys evicted in 5 seconds. Cache hit ratio dropped from 94% to 11%.
root_cause: Redis cache eviction cascade caused by a bulk product sync job storing uncompressed session tokens in the main catalog Redis cluster without TTL.
resolution_steps:
1. Separated session tokens into a dedicated Redis instance.
2. Configured all catalog cache items with mandatory 1-hour max TTL.
3. Increased maxmemory policy to allkeys-lru on catalog cluster.

symptoms_summary: Payment processing callbacks failing with HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout and socket hangup errors.
log_excerpt: 2026-09-27 18:45:11 ERROR [payment-gateway] upstream HTTP 504 gateway timeout from payment-processor.example.com; socket hangup after 30000ms.
root_cause: Upstream payment provider third-party webhooks experienced DNS routing failures and network socket timeouts during regional ISP outage.
resolution_steps:
1. Enabled asynchronous payment retry queue with exponential backoff.
2. Switched primary payment route to secondary processor gateway.
3. Notified payment provider support of DNS resolution failures.
